subject: Insurance
title: Risk vs. Uncertainty
description: Learn Risk vs. Uncertainty in one minute.

hook.text: Risk is when you know the odds. Uncertainty is when you don't. Insurance handles risk well. Uncertainty can destroy it.

buildup.text: Frank Knight defined the difference in 1921. A coin flip is risk—50/50.

discovery.text: Insurers thrive on risk because they can calculate premiums.

twist.text: Climate change is shifting risks into uncertainties. Historical data no longer predicts future hurricanes.

climax.text: The boundary between risk and uncertainty defines what's insurable. When that line moves, so does the insurance market.

punchline.text: Known odds: risk. Unknown odds: uncertainty.

quiz.question: What's the key difference between risk and uncertainty?
options: Risk has calculable odds; uncertainty doesn't
